verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is an API-first product with extensive first-party documentation for the Payments API v3, Data API, Verification API, mandates/VRP and webhooks. It also offers a sandbox quickstart, official SDKs in four languages, and open-source signing libraries on GitHub, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. An llms.txt and markdown versions of the docs make it agent-friendly. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as documented.
